newsitem.title: CHINA: HK industrial production index down 3.1 pct in Q1.
newsitem.headline: HK industrial production index down 3.1 pct in Q1.

text.p: Hong Kong's index of industrial production decreased by 3.1 percent in the first quarter of 1997, the Census and Statistics department said on Thursday.
Textiles output was down 3.7 percent and that of electrical and electronic products, machinery, professional equipment and optical goods fell 4.8 percent.
Consumer electrical and electronic products output decreased by 7.3 percent. Chemicals, rubber, plastic and non-metallic mineral products output rose 2.6 percent.
Food, beverages and tobacco output increased 2.2 percent while paper products and printing output fell 4.4 percent.
Basic metals and fabricated metal products output decreased 6.6 percent and that of machinery, equipment, apparatus, parts and components fell 2.7 percent.
Production of wearing apparel, except footwear, was down 3.8 percent.
